summary: which stitch in this niche will switch a glitch so instead it enriches kids in unhitched fitness to witness evidence pitched in fast-stiched quilts of knowledge Find THAT string and ring its school bell #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
which stitch
  in this
niche
will
switch
a glitch
so instead
it enriches
 kids
in unhitched
  fitness
  to witness
evidence
    pitched
in fast-stiched
quilts
of
knowledge
  Find THAT string
and ring its
school bell
#smallpoems
